title: Hourly services and expenses
author: Trey Hunner
provenance: Manual transcription of a public template sample; not AI output or a real commercial transaction.
notes: Invoice number and PO are not printed. USD is inferred from the dollar symbol and US address. The printed subtotal is 419.08; individual rounded amounts sum to 419.09. Values are retained as printed.

title: Item and amount invoice
author: Sparksuite
provenance: Manual transcription of a public template sample; not AI output or a real commercial transaction.
notes: Public PDF rendering of the Sparksuite template, with an MIT notice printed above it. No quantities, unit prices or PO are printed. USD is inferred from the dollar symbol and US address. Template revision records the license source, not the PDF renderer revision.

title: Japanese bank-transfer invoice
author: NI57721
provenance: Manual transcription of a public template sample; not AI output or a real commercial transaction.
notes: Original published PNG. Subtotal JPY 2,400,000, consumption tax JPY 240,000, total JPY 2,640,000. No PO is printed. JPY is identified by the yen labels. The optional Service Qux note is not an invoiced line.

title: Paid invoice with a discount row
author: Baptiste Jamin
provenance: Saved local Qwen output; corrections replayed from the isolated review database. Not approved.
notes: Negative discount is a separate printed row. Only line subtotals are printed, so unit prices remain blank. Date 22/10/21 is interpreted as 2021-10-22. Paid is the source label, not approval in this app. Sequential review row IDs are assigned where the source has no numeric row IDs.

title: Line-level discounts and mixed taxes
author: go-invoice-generator contributors
provenance: Saved local Qwen output; corrections replayed from the isolated review database. Not approved.
notes: The reference testref is not labelled an invoice number. French date 02/03/2021 is interpreted as 2021-03-02. Line totals use the printed Total no tax column BEFORE discounts. The PDF also has percentage/fixed discounts and tax amounts, which this review model does not calculate. Printed totals are retained, not reconciled. Sequential review row IDs are assigned where the source has no numeric row IDs.

title: Letter invoice with a service period
author: Florian Moser
provenance: Saved local Qwen output; corrections replayed from the isolated review database. Not approved.
notes: No currency is printed; currency remains blank. Project reference ZI-2812-F is not treated as a PO. Quantities are hours. The printed VAT is 14%; this sample is not tax guidance. Sequential review row IDs are assigned where the source has no numeric row IDs.

title: Repair services with multiline descriptions
author: invoice2data contributors
provenance: Saved local Qwen output; corrections replayed from the isolated review database. Not approved.
notes: The PDF explicitly uses fictitious names. The dollar symbol alone does not identify a currency, so currency remains blank. A PO number is printed, but no purchase order document is supplied. Parts and tax notes belong to the two service rows; they are not extra invoice lines. The summary prints tax 0%, independently of the line notes. Sequential review row IDs are assigned where the source has no numeric row IDs.

title: Product sections, subtotals and a discount
author: invoice2data contributors
provenance: Saved local Qwen output; corrections replayed from the isolated review database. Not approved.
notes: USD is inferred from dollar symbols and US addresses. CUSTREF123 is a customer reference, not a PO. Section headings and subtotals are not invoice lines. Olive Oil has a 10% discount: unit price 1.00 and line amount 0.90. Preserve these printed amounts without forcing quantity × unit price to match. Sequential review row IDs are assigned where the source has no numeric row IDs.
